children: IHH Healthcare's ambulatory care center expansion in Malaysia is expected to support growth through higher patient turnover and better use of existing facilities, CIMB Securities analyst Chun Sung Oong says in a note. The planned acquisition of Afiniti Wellness in Johor will expand Gleneagles Hospital Medini's outpatient services and free up hospital capacity for more complex cases, he reckons. The acquisition value wasn't disclosed, but he views the acquisition positively. Day-care patients can be treated at least three times faster than in-patients, improving operating efficiency despite generating 40%-50% less revenue per case, he adds. CIMB maintains a buy rating on IHH and keeps its target price at 10.30 ringgit. Shares are 1.3% higher at 8.00 ringgit. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
